# Meeting Copilot Support

> Public support and legal pages for Meeting Copilot.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-29

## Public pages

- Support: https://p1xel32.github.io/cch-support/
- Privacy: https://p1xel32.github.io/cch-support/privacy.html
- Terms: https://p1xel32.github.io/cch-support/terms.html

## Scope

This repository hosts public support, privacy, and terms pages for App Store and user-support purposes.

The application source and service implementation are maintained separately. Do not infer internal architecture, model providers, subscription implementation, or security behavior from this support repository alone.

For support contact details, use the currently published support page rather than copying stale addresses from secondary sources.
